checkpoint_selection: Train every allowed generator to 3000 actual G updates. For G0, train independent TSTR classifiers at 500/1500/3000 using the frozen raw classifier budget and seeds1042/1043/1044. Choose the common G checkpoint by three-seed mean full-24s validation argmax macro-F1, tie fewer G updates. G1 uses this same G checkpoint; per-prefix matching validation is quality diagnostics, not an alternate source for test selection.
TSTR_scope: Synthetic-only classifier training with real-training-only scaler; predictions evaluated on real matching-prefix and full-24s validation. Not a label-truth certificate.
G1_gate: Use raw_baseline_freeze teacher gate; when false skip both positive-weight variants and record unmet prerequisite, not a successful G1 experiment.
variant_ratio_selection: For each allowed weight select ratio by mean over the three paired classifier/generator repeats of common full-24s validation argmax macro-F1, round8 ties smaller ratio. For the exploratory G1 comparison select among weights0.1/1.0 by that score, tie smaller weight. Preserve G0, selected G1 if eligible, best ROS, both same-count ROS, and raw. Ratio0 aliases raw.
teacher_evaluation: External raw real-data classifier is frozen; independent TSTR models initialize from scratch. Direct quality measures and all-class real validation remain separate from teacher consistency.
synthetic_filter: off; all finite generated samples admitted, exact duplicate counts retained, no mechanical nonnegative filter on noisy measured RPM
gradient_logs: Each row: G single-batch adversarial/CE/total loss and gradient norm; D real/fake/gap/GP/gradient norm averaged over its five actual updates. Report averaging difference.
fixed_probes: At each generator checkpoint, same class counts and bank seed seed+15000 produce identical latent/class probes under a forked torch RNG. Training stream is restored after probing.
quality_reference: Same chosen prefix/window real validation pool; demeaned PSD, lag correlations, cross-channel relations, Wasserstein/KS, training NN; all admitted windows checked for finite values/counts/exact duplicates, expensive distances use fixed32/class. No generated absolute-stage labels.
